statutory_act: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 read with Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

size.description: Size / Dimensions of commodity in centimeters (cm), meters (m), or millimeters (mm) if relevant.
size.statutory_citation: Rule 6(1)(f): Where the package contains items sold by size or dimension, size/dimensions in metric units.
size.remedy: Declare size/dimensions in standard metric units (cm/m/mm) on the principal display panel.
